statement: (let bump := fun (a b t : ℝ) => if a < t ∧ t < b then Real.exp (-1/((t-a)*(b-t))) else 0; let W := bump 1 (51/50); let b := bump (-1/40) (1/40); let k := fun (t : ℝ) => ∫ v : ℝ, b v * Real.cos (2*Real.pi*v*t); let l := fun (t : ℝ) => Real.sin (Real.pi*t/5)*k t; let T := fun (X : ℕ) => 2*Real.pi*(X:ℝ); let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let u := fun (X n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * W ((n:ℝ)/X) / Real.sqrt n; let P := fun (X : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (w X).sum (fun n => (u X n : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-Complex.I*(t:ℂ)*(Real.log n : ℂ))); let I := fun (X : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) => ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (l (t/T X))^2*(1+σ*Real.cos (4*Real.pi*t/T X))*‖P X t‖^2; ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ δ*T X < I X 1-I X (-1)) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let M := fun (X : ℕ) => (w X).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∀ (K : ℝ) (B : ℕ), ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ K * e X < M X)
